name: verify_insurance
description: Check the verified patient's insurance with the insurer in real time: whether coverage is active, the office visit copay and the deductible left. Only works after find_patient passed. Ask for the insurance company's name and the member ID exactly as printed on the card (for Medicare, the 11-character Medicare number on the red, white and blue card). Say only what the result says; it is not a guarantee of payment. Two checks per call.

payer_name.description: Insurance company or plan name as the caller says it, e.g. Aetna or Medicare.

member_id.description: Member ID (or Medicare number) as printed on the card.
